source: EP-0139 (catalog J10); statistic and classes pre-registered in the audit repo before any letter was measured

gillogly-ciphermidleft.class_read_as: none (the row-offset test is forced by the plate seam between rows 13 and 14, a pre-registration design error)

verdict_extra_l: undecided (no public photo shows the tableau row whole at usable resolution)
design_errors: row-offset test compares gaps 13->14 and 14->15, but a plate seam lies between rows 13 and 14
pitch P is a median that includes the seam gap, 1.25-1.34 times the in-plate pitch, so residuals in P are understated
pitch_cm_note: 11.7 cm is the in-plate row pitch; P (the pre-registered unit) includes the seam gap

ep0145.combined_rule: intended if an independent third photo X is 'intended' and no photo shows local construction; not intended if X is 'none' with in-plate pitch >= 100 px, taken from the front, and all of Y, A, R below T; otherwise undecided

rubbing_ndy.note: auxiliary only (paper distortion); direction up, about 1 cm

antipodes.note: one-sided rule: no lift on Antipodes says nothing about Kryptos
